clues.title: A key the desk never made
clues.summary: The man at the desk for 1418 had a working keycard for the room, but the encoding log shows no key made for him. Somebody is making Veldane keys outside the front desk.

clues.title: The man in the grey cap
clues.summary: A man took a floor master from an unattended trolley, tried a vacant room and an occupied one, then left by the stairs. He knew where the trolley would be and which rooms were empty.

clues.title: A fourth encoder
clues.summary: E-77 is a portable encoder registered to the Harbourfront's lock system at 03:12 one night, through a shared login whose password was taped under a keyboard. It made 31 keys the desk never logged.

clues.title: The airport hotel
clues.summary: E-77 came from a reseller that also supplied the Veldane Airport Port Avener, where eleven rooms were entered with valid keys this year using the same shared-login trick. Whoever it is knows Veldane systems from the inside.

clues.title: The administrator who left
clues.summary: Dorian Vessey ran the front office systems at both Port Avener hotels and resigned seven months ago. His shared login fo_support and his vendor remote-support access were never removed, and fo_support registered E-77 eleven weeks after he left.

clues.title: Four hundred blank cards
clues.summary: The police found a second encoder, a card printer and four hundred blank Veldane cards at Vessey's flat. Someone has been buying cards from him, and the police are looking for them.
